## Contribution

Is this **one new signed CRL discovery header** under `index/`, or an
infrastructure/governance change?

For a scientific index submission:

- [ ] The research object is already published at the exact Zenodo Version DOI.
- [ ] This PR adds exactly one new file under the content-addressed `index/` path.
- [ ] Creator, rights, licence, and relation-scope declarations are accurate to the best of my knowledge.
- [ ] I understand indexing does not transfer research ownership to the Commons.
- [ ] Known relevant objections are not intentionally omitted when carrying work forward.
- [ ] No secrets or private data are included.

Index admission is not scientific acceptance. The validator does not fetch or
execute Zenodo artifacts. Infrastructure, registry, policy, and schema changes
are never auto-admitted.
